# Plan your card sign-up bonuses around your real spending

> Plan credit card sign-up bonuses: track minimum-spend deadlines, see your 5/24 count and issuer velocity limits, compare net value after the annual fee, and get an application schedule that fits your monthly spending. Free, private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
